facts.text: I want to catalogue everything that I own in my house.
Some of the stuff I own might be used forever.
Some of the stuff I own might have expiration dates like food or skincare.
Some of the stuff I own needs maintenance.
Some of the stuff I own can contain many other stuff, like pouches and shelves.
I want to expand the "products" to become everything I own.
I am deciding whether to create a separate database for cataloguing everything I own or to use the same database.
I am deciding whether the main database should be the product wishlist or inventory.
